_comment: Hand-crafted loci for the Technique Palace (utils/kg_palace). Room order is the fixed route - never reorder; loci depend on it. Station images/triggers are pegs: edit only deliberately.

rooms.name: The Pantry
rooms.flavor: Jars, tallies, and pigeonholes — asking what a collection holds.

rooms.name: The Conveyor Hall
rooms.flavor: One pass, no going back: interrogate each item, then file it.

rooms.name: The Sorting Office
rooms.flavor: Mile markers and height lines — order and position do the work.

rooms.name: The Long Gallery
rooms.flavor: Walkers and picture frames moving along one long wall.

rooms.name: The Plate Room
rooms.flavor: What was opened last, what crushes what, who gets evicted.

rooms.name: The Train Shed
rooms.flavor: Carriages, couplings, and a decoy engine.

rooms.name: The Halving Vault
rooms.flavor: Every question throws away half of what remains.

rooms.name: The Arboretum
rooms.flavor: Envelopes passed up, backpacks passed down.

rooms.name: The Catacombs
rooms.flavor: Chalk marks, ripples, and merging circles.

rooms.name: The Hall of Mirrors
rooms.flavor: The same problem, smaller, in every reflection.

rooms.name: The Clockwork Room
rooms.flavor: Switches, gears, and things that wrap around.

rooms.name: The Print Shop
rooms.flavor: Type set letter by letter; corridors of lettered doors.

set-membership.image: A bouncer at the pantry door holds a guest list: one glance, in or out.
set-membership.trigger: “Have I seen this exact value?” — instant yes/no lookups.

set-algebra.image: Two hula hoops overlap on the floor; you scoop what lies in the lens.
set-algebra.trigger: What’s in both lists? In one but not the other?

counter-build.image: A turnstile clicker in your hand, clicking once per item that passes.

counter-multiset-ops.image: Two grocery baskets: subtract basket B from A — nothing may be left over.
counter-multiset-ops.trigger: Can A be assembled from B’s letters or parts?

counts-as-data.image: You turn the tally sheet sideways and study the tally marks themselves.
counts-as-data.trigger: The question is about the counts, not the items (all counts unique?).

dict-arbitrary-value.image: Pigeonholes stuffed with addresses and notes — not tallies.
dict-arbitrary-value.trigger: Remember something *about* each key: last index, mapped char.

bijection-check.image: A dance floor where every dancer has exactly one partner — checked both ways.
bijection-check.trigger: Do two sequences map one-to-one, both directions?

streaming-ask-then-record.image: Items ride a belt; you interrogate each one, *then* stamp it into the ledger.
streaming-ask-then-record.trigger: One pass: does my partner already exist? Ask first, then record me.

derived-key-lookup.image: You compute each item’s nickname and file it under the nickname.
derived-key-lookup.trigger: File items under a computed alias (sorted letters, shape signature).

solve-pair-condition.image: An algebra mirror: you shuffle the equation until the partner’s face appears in it.
solve-pair-condition.trigger: Rearrange the pair condition until it reads “find my complement.”

streaming-accumulate-pairs.image: Each newcomer shakes hands with every matching earlier arrival; you tally handshakes.
streaming-accumulate-pairs.trigger: Count pairs in one pass — add matches-so-far *before* recording.

running-extreme.image: A high-water mark creeping up the wall as the belt runs.

running-sum.image: A snowball rolling along the belt, growing as it goes.

seen-state-cycle-detect.image: A breadcrumb trail; you step on your own footprint and know you’re looping.
seen-state-cycle-detect.trigger: An iterated process — does it settle or repeat forever?

prefix-sums.image: Mile markers along a road: any stretch is the difference of two markers.
prefix-sums.trigger: Many range-sum questions over a fixed array.

prefix-sum-hashmap.image: A logbook of every odometer reading you’ve seen, and when.
prefix-sum-hashmap.trigger: How many subarrays sum to k?

sort-then-adjacent.image: Everyone lines up by height; you only compare each person to their neighbor.
sort-then-adjacent.trigger: Closest pair, duplicates-within-range — sort, then only neighbors matter.

sort-by-custom-key.image: A judge sorting contestants by hat size, ignoring everything else.
sort-by-custom-key.trigger: Order things by a derived property.

counting-sort-buckets.image: Twenty-six labeled buckets; toss letters in, then read the buckets in order.
counting-sort-buckets.trigger: Small fixed alphabet or range — bucket, don’t compare.

two-pointers-converging.image: Two walkers start at opposite ends of the gallery and step inward by rule.
two-pointers-converging.trigger: Sorted array + pair target; container between two ends.

two-pointers-read-write.image: Two cursors: a reader skims ahead, a writer inks the clean copy just behind.

fast-slow-pointers.image: Tortoise and hare on the gallery’s circular track — if it loops, they meet.
fast-slow-pointers.trigger: Is there a cycle? Where is the middle?

sliding-window-fixed.image: A fixed picture frame slides along a mural: gain the new edge, lose the old.

sliding-window-variable.image: An accordion: stretch until the rule breaks, squeeze until it holds again.
sliding-window-variable.trigger: Longest / shortest stretch satisfying a condition.

stack-matching.image: Nesting dolls: every lid must fit the most recently opened doll.
stack-matching.trigger: Nested things that must close in reverse order (brackets).

monotonic-stack.image: A stack of plates where each new taller plate crushes every shorter one beneath it.
monotonic-stack.trigger: Next greater / next smaller element; spans and horizons.

deque-recent-window.image: A VIP queue with bouncers at *both* doors: the stale leave the front, the unworthy the back.
deque-recent-window.trigger: Max or min over a sliding window.

ll-dummy-splice.image: You couple a decoy carriage to the front of the train so surgery near the engine is safe.
ll-dummy-splice.trigger: Deleting or inserting near the head.

ll-pointer-reversal.image: Walking the train, uncoupling each carriage and re-hitching it to face backwards.
ll-pointer-reversal.trigger: Reverse the list; re-aim the links.

ll-offset-arithmetic.image: Two runners hold a fixed gap; when the front one hits the buffer, the back one stands at the answer.
ll-offset-arithmetic.trigger: Nth from the end; where two trains merge.

binary-search-index.image: A dictionary: open dead middle, discard half, repeat.
binary-search-index.trigger: Find a target in something sorted.

binary-search-boundary.image: The tide line: the exact grain of sand where wet turns dry.
binary-search-boundary.trigger: First / last position where a condition flips.

binary-search-on-answer.image: A safe dial: guess a setting, ask “does it open?”, tighten the range.
binary-search-on-answer.trigger: Least speed / capacity that still works — feasibility is monotone.

tree-dfs-recursive.image: You descend the family tree trusting each child to report on their own branch.
tree-dfs-recursive.trigger: Visit every node; answer a per-node question.

tree-combine-returns.image: Children hand up sealed envelopes; you merge them and pass one envelope up.
tree-combine-returns.trigger: Answer at a node = f(left’s answer, right’s answer).

tree-carry-down.image: A backpack of context handed down to each child at every fork.
tree-carry-down.trigger: A child needs context from above: the path so far, the bounds.

tree-global-across-subtrees.image: A bulletin board in the hall: every branch pins its best; records may span left and right.
tree-global-across-subtrees.trigger: The best path may *bend* through a node (diameter).

tree-bfs-levels.image: Wedding photographs taken floor by floor of the greenhouse.

bst-invariant.image: The estate’s iron rule: smaller relatives in the west wing, larger in the east.
bst-invariant.trigger: It’s a BST — exploit left < node < right.

tree-build-from-traversals.image: Reassembling a hanging mobile from two flat photographs of it.
tree-build-from-traversals.trigger: Rebuild the tree from preorder + inorder.

graph-adjacency-build.image: Compiling the phone book: each person, then the list of their friends.
graph-adjacency-build.trigger: Given edges — build neighbor lists before anything else.

graph-dfs-visited.image: Chalk-marking every cave you enter so you never wander back in.
graph-dfs-visited.trigger: Explore a region or component fully (islands).

graph-bfs-shortest.image: Ripples from a dropped stone — the first ripple to reach you took the shortest path.
graph-bfs-shortest.trigger: Fewest steps through an unweighted graph or grid.

union-find.image: Circles at a party merging; each circle answers through one spokesperson.
union-find.trigger: Dynamic “same group?” queries while things merge.

topological-order.image: Getting dressed: socks before shoes — repeatedly take whatever has nothing pending.
topological-order.trigger: Prerequisites; schedule tasks in dependency order.

backtracking-choose-undo.image: Trying outfits: put on, check the mirror, take off, try the next.

memoize-recursion.image: A diary nailed at the cave mouth: “asked before — answer inside.”
memoize-recursion.trigger: The same subproblem keeps recurring — cache it.

dp-state-formulate.image: Labeling every mirror with coordinates, so any reflection is known by its label alone.
dp-state-formulate.trigger: Name “where am I” so the future depends only on the label.

dp-1d-rolling.image: Crossing stepping stones while holding only the last two stones’ numbers.
dp-1d-rolling.trigger: f(i) from f(i−1) and f(i−2) — keep two variables, not an array.

dp-2d-grid.image: Tiling a wall where every tile is computed from its upper and left neighbors.
dp-2d-grid.trigger: Grid paths, edit distance — each cell from up and left.

heap-top-k.image: A podium with exactly k seats; each newcomer shoves off the weakest champion.

heap-simulation.image: Triage: always treat the most urgent patient, who may rejoin the queue.
heap-simulation.trigger: Repeatedly take the most extreme, transform it, put it back.

greedy-sort-take.image: A buffet run: best dishes first, while the plate still holds.
greedy-sort-take.trigger: Sort by value; take while it fits.

interval-overlap.image: Meeting cards laid on a timeline; overlapping cards stack into piles.
interval-overlap.trigger: Meetings and intervals — overlap, merge, minimum rooms.

xor-cancellation.image: Paired dancers annihilate in puffs of smoke; the loner remains standing.

bit-iterate.image: A row of thirty-two switches read one by one.
bit-iterate.trigger: Count or inspect the bits of a number.

divmod-decompose.image: Making change: how many tens (div), and what’s left in your palm (mod).
divmod-decompose.trigger: Split a number into digits, columns, or groups.

gcd-reduction.image: Tiling a floor with the largest square that fits both walls exactly.
gcd-reduction.trigger: Reduce a ratio; find the common measure.

pair-count-formula.image: n glasses clinking: you *compute* the clinks — n(n−1)/2 — instead of counting them.
pair-count-formula.trigger: Count pairs with arithmetic, not loops.

modular-cycle.image: The clock face: thirteen o’clock is simply one.

string-build-transform.image: A letterpress: setting type into the compositor’s stick, one sort at a time.
string-build-transform.trigger: Build the output string character by character.

trie-build-walk.image: A branching corridor where every door bears a letter; words are walks.
